title: Face
description: A tracked face in the live camera feed, with landmarks, mouth-open ratio, assigned speaker color, and consent status.

id.description: Stable track identifier for this face during the session (e.g. 'face-1').

box.description: Normalized face bounding box in [0, 1] relative to video frame width and height.

lips.description: Normalized [x, y] lip contour landmark coordinates in [0, 1] from MediaPipe Face Landmarker.

mouth_open.description: Mouth-open ratio (inner lip vertical gap divided by mouth width). Used for UI telemetry and FB6 uncalibrated fallback.

color.description: Assigned high-contrast hex color for this speaker.

given.description: Whether this person has explicitly consented to captioning and saving.

by.description: Name or identifier of the person or operator who recorded consent, or null if not given.

time.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when consent was recorded, or null if not given.

is_target.description: Optional convenience flag indicating whether this face is currently the active target.

label.description: Optional display name for a consenting speaker.
